paragraphs: Rav Yosef son of Rav Sala the Pious.

Hyman says he always appears with the formula "he explained it before Rav Papa" (targema kamei de-Rav Papa), as in [Pesachim 73b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.73b.11), [Chullin 74b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.74b.9), [Arakhin 33b](https://www.sefaria.org/Arakhin.33b.24).[^1][^2][^3][^4]

notes.text: חסידא, “the Pious,” qualifies Sala in the patronymic. Both Rav titles are written fully in the heading.

בשם introduces the recurring formula “he explained it before Rav Papa”; it does not make Rav Papa the source of a transmitted statement. תרגמא here means explained or interpreted. Hyman’s “always” describes his own survey.
The printed locators עג:, עד:, לג: are rendered Pesachim 73b, Chullin 74b and Arakhin 33b.

[Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2031&lang=en) cites the same three appearances. Rav Yosef explains the teaching in Rav Papa’s presence. The Arakhin sentence continues on [Arakhin 34a](https://www.sefaria.org/Arakhin.34a.1).
